as.description: Extensions and SEPs adopted on v1 once the 2026-07-28 revision shipped: Skills, Server Cards, progressive tool discovery, Streamable HTTP over stdio, webhooks and EMA, Mcp-Param headers, and the client defaulting to the modern protocol. Several stay experimental until their SEP or working group settles.

description.from: server/discover, MRTR/InputRequiredResult with resultType, subscriptions/listen, drop Mcp-Session-Id, Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers, CacheableResult (ttlMs/cacheScope), W3C trace context, extensions capability map, MCP Apps + Tasks as extensions, error renumbering, deprecate roots/sampling/logging. Behind Stateless opt-in until spec final.
description.to: Stateless became the Streamable HTTP default in v1.24.0 (a minor, not v2: mcp-go has only first-party consumers). Spec alignment through 2026-07-28 completed in v1.26.0 (#141). No /v2 module path is planned.
